results.title: SIGCDMX — cadastral data download
results.note: Official page says catastro files include geographic polygons by parcel and associated account data; downloadable datasets, not an anonymous live feature endpoint.

assessment: Strong official discovery: city cadastral polygons and account data can be downloaded by borough. Need verify current download URLs, stable IDs, completeness and licensing before integration.
note: Native-language discovery only; does not change the historical registry or assert that no source exists.
